      "source": [
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "# Load the livestock dataset\n",
        "df = pd.read_csv('/content/livestock_data.csv')\n",
        "\n",
        "# Convert date column into a proper date format\n",
        "df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])\n",
        "\n",
        "# Display the first five rows\n",
        "display(df.head())"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "print(\"Dataset size:\", df.shape)\n",
        "print(\"\\nColumn names:\")\n",
        "print(df.columns.tolist())\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nUnique animals:\", df['animal_id'].nunique())\n",
        "print(\"Unique herds:\", df['herd_id'].nunique())\n",
        "print(\"Missing values:\")\n",
        "print(df.isnull().sum())"
      ],

            "\n",

            "Unique herds: 3\n",
            "Missing values:\n",
            "date              0\n",
            "animal_id         0\n",
            "herd_id           0\n",
            "district          0\n",
            "lat               0\n",
            "lon               0\n",
            "activity_level    0\n",
            "body_temp_c       0\n",
            "dtype: int64\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "def haversine(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):\n",
        "    # Convert degrees to radians\n",
        "    lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2 = np.radians([lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2])\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Differences between coordinates\n",
        "    dlat = lat2 - lat1\n",
        "    dlon = lon2 - lon1\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Haversine formula\n",
        "    a = np.sin(dlat / 2) ** 2 + np.cos(lat1) * np.cos(lat2) * np.sin(dlon / 2) ** 2\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Earth's approximate radius in kilometres\n",
        "    earth_radius = 6371\n",
        "\n",
        "    return 2 * earth_radius * np.arcsin(np.sqrt(np.clip(a, 0, 1)))\n",
        "\n",
        "# Sort animals by ID and date\n",
        "df = df.sort_values(['animal_id', 'date']).copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Get each animal's previous GPS position\n",
        "df['previous_lat'] = df.groupby('animal_id')['lat'].shift(1)\n",
        "df['previous_lon'] = df.groupby('animal_id')['lon'].shift(1)\n",
        "df['previous_date'] = df.groupby('animal_id')['date'].shift(1)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Calculate distance moved in kilometres\n",
        "df['distance_km'] = haversine(\n",
        "    df['previous_lat'],\n",
        "    df['previous_lon'],\n",
        "    df['lat'],\n",
        "    df['lon']\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# The first record for each animal has no previous location\n",
        "df.loc[df['previous_date'].isna(), 'distance_km'] = np.nan\n",
        "\n",
        "# Display movement calculations\n",
        "display(df[['date', 'animal_id', 'herd_id', 'distance_km']].head(15))"
      ],

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Calculate herd averages and standard deviations\n",
        "# for each date\n",
        "\n",
        "group = df.groupby(['date', 'herd_id'])\n",
        "\n",
        "df['activity_mean'] = group['activity_level'].transform('mean')\n",
        "df['activity_std'] = group['activity_level'].transform('std')\n",
        "\n",
        "df['movement_mean'] = group['distance_km'].transform('mean')\n",
        "df['movement_std'] = group['distance_km'].transform('std')\n",
        "\n",
        "# Calculate activity z-scores\n",
        "df['activity_z'] = (\n",
        "    (df['activity_level'] - df['activity_mean'])\n",
        "    / df['activity_std'].replace(0, np.nan)\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Calculate movement z-scores\n",
        "df['movement_z'] = (\n",
        "    (df['distance_km'] - df['movement_mean'])\n",
        "    / df['movement_std'].replace(0, np.nan)\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Display results\n",
        "display(\n",
        "    df[[\n",
        "        'date', 'animal_id', 'herd_id',\n",
        "        'activity_level', 'activity_z',\n",
        "        'distance_km', 'movement_z'\n",
        "    ]].tail(15)\n",
        ")"
      ],

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# Illustrative body-temperature threshold\n",
        "HIGH_TEMP = 39.5\n",
        "\n",
        "# Identify unusual behaviour\n",
        "df['low_activity'] = df['activity_z'] < -2\n",
        "df['high_temperature'] = df['body_temp_c'] >= HIGH_TEMP\n",
        "df['unusual_movement'] = df['movement_z'] > 2\n",
        "\n",
        "# Combine the indicators\n",
        "df['possible_illness'] = (\n",
        "    df['low_activity'] & df['high_temperature']\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "df['flagged'] = (\n",
        "    df['possible_illness']\n",
        "    | df['low_activity']\n",
        "    | df['unusual_movement']\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Display the flagged records\n",
        "flagged_df = df[df['flagged']].copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Total flagged records:\", len(flagged_df))\n",
        "print(\"Animals flagged:\", flagged_df['animal_id'].nunique())\n",
        "\n",
        "display(\n",
        "    flagged_df[[\n",
        "        'date', 'animal_id', 'herd_id',\n",
        "        'activity_level', 'body_temp_c',\n",
        "        'distance_km', 'activity_z', 'movement_z',\n",
        "        'possible_illness', 'unusual_movement'\n",
        "    ]].head(30)\n",
        ")"
      ],

      "source": [
        "def make_reason(row):\n",
        "    reasons = []\n",
        "\n",
        "    if row['possible_illness']:\n",
        "        reasons.append(\"Low activity with high body temperature\")\n",
        "    elif row['low_activity']:\n",
        "        reasons.append(\"Activity unusually low compared with herd\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    if row['unusual_movement']:\n",
        "        reasons.append(\"Movement unusually high compared with herd\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    return \"; \".join(reasons)\n",
        "\n",
        "def make_advice(row):\n",
        "    if row['possible_illness']:\n",
        "        return (\n",
        "            \"Check the animal promptly and contact a veterinary \"\n",
        "            \"professional if the signs persist.\"\n",
        "        )\n",
        "    elif row['unusual_movement']:\n",
        "        return (\n",
        "            \"Check the animal's location and confirm that it is \"\n",
        "            \"safe and accounted for.\"\n",
        "        )\n",
        "    else:\n",
        "        return (\n",
        "            \"Observe the animal closely and check for changes \"\n",
        "            \"in health, feeding and behaviour.\"\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "def make_setswana_advice(row):\n",
        "    if row['possible_illness']:\n",
        "        return (\n",
        "            \"Tlhatlhoba phologolo ka bonako, mme o ikgolaganye \"\n",
        "            \"le ngaka ya diphologolo fa matshwao a tswelela.\"\n",
        "        )\n",
        "    elif row['unusual_movement']:\n",
        "        return (\n",
        "            \"Netefatsa lefelo la phologolo mme o tlhomamise gore \"\n",
        "            \"e babalesegile.\"\n",
        "        )\n",
        "    else:\n",
        "        return (\n",
        "            \"Ela tlhoko phologolo mme o lekole diphetogo mo \"\n",
        "            \"botsogong le mo maitsholong a yone.\"\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "# Create the alert records\n",
        "alerts = flagged_df.copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "alerts['type'] = 'livestock'\n",
        "alerts['risk_level'] = np.where(\n",
        "    alerts['possible_illness'], 'High', 'Medium'\n",
        ")\n",
        "alerts['reason'] = alerts.apply(make_reason, axis=1)\n",
        "alerts['advice_en'] = alerts.apply(make_advice, axis=1)\n",
        "alerts['advice_tn'] = alerts.apply(make_setswana_advice, axis=1)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Keep the shared fields plus animal identification details\n",
        "alerts = alerts[[\n",
        "    'district',\n",
        "    'type',\n",
        "    'risk_level',\n",
        "    'reason',\n",
        "    'advice_en',\n",
        "    'advice_tn',\n",
        "    'date',\n",
        "    'animal_id',\n",
        "    'herd_id',\n",
        "    'distance_km',\n",
        "    'activity_level',\n",
        "    'body_temp_c'\n",
        "]].copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Save the file\n",
        "alerts.to_csv('/content/livestock_alerts.csv', index=False)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Saved livestock_alerts.csv\")\n",
        "display(alerts.head(20))"
      ],

            "application/javascript": [
              "\n",
              "    async function download(id, filename, size) {\n",
              "      if (!google.colab.kernel.accessAllowed) {\n",
              "        return;\n",
              "      }\n",
              "      const div = document.createElement('div');\n",
              "      const label = document.createElement('label');\n",
              "      label.textContent = `Downloading \"${filename}\": `;\n",
              "      div.appendChild(label);\n",
              "      const progress = document.createElement('progress');\n",
              "      progress.max = size;\n",
              "      div.appendChild(progress);\n",
              "      document.body.appendChild(div);\n",
              "\n",
              "      const buffers = [];\n",
              "      let downloaded = 0;\n",
              "\n",
              "      const channel = await google.colab.kernel.comms.open(id);\n",
              "      // Send a message to notify the kernel that we're ready.\n",
              "      channel.send({})\n",
              "\n",
              "      for await (const message of channel.messages) {\n",
              "        // Send a message to notify the kernel that we're ready.\n",
              "        channel.send({})\n",
              "        if (message.buffers) {\n",
              "          for (const buffer of message.buffers) {\n",
              "            buffers.push(buffer);\n",
              "            downloaded += buffer.byteLength;\n",
              "            progress.value = downloaded;\n",
              "          }\n",
              "        }\n",
              "      }\n",
              "      const blob = new Blob(buffers, {type: 'application/binary'});\n",
              "      const a = document.createElement('a');\n",
              "      a.href = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);\n",
              "      a.download = filename;\n",
              "      div.appendChild(a);\n",
              "      a.click();\n",
              "      div.remove();\n",
              "    }\n",
              "  "
            ]
          },
          "metadata": {}
